title: Issue when upgrading from legacy windows installer
body:
### Issue Description

I am on windows 11 and wanted to update Podman using Podman Desktop. It uninstalled the the old installation automaticly but failed installing the new one.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Install old Podman version
2. Uninstall old Podman version
3. Install new Podman version


### Describe the results you received

Successfull Install of new Podman version

### Describe the results you expected

Error saying the old incompatible version is still installed

### podman info output

```yaml
OS: windows/amd64
provider: wsl
version: 5.8.5

Cannot connect to Podman. Please verify your connection to the Linux system using `podman system connection list`, or try `podman machine init` and `podman machine start` to manage a new Linux VM
Error: unable to connect to Podman socket: knownhosts: C:\Users\*****\.ssh\known_hosts:2: ssh: rsa modulus too large
```

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Privileged

### Upstream Latest Release

Yes

### Additional environment details

`%programfiles%\RedHat\Podman` still existed but was empty.

`HKLM:\Software\Red Hat\{Podman,Update}` existed but was empty besides a `Podman\InstallDir` with the old path. 

### Additional information

Manualy cleaning up after uninstallation by deleting the old folder and registry keys allowed the new installation to work.

comments.body: The ssh error is unrelated and a diffrent issue of podman only using ssh which comes bundled with windows disregarding an new version installed from https://github.com/PowerShell/Win32-OpenSSH directly and in path.
